fullstack.title: FullStack Development
fullstack.summary: End-to-end web applications with premium UX, scalable architecture, and production-ready code.
fullstack.tagline: From prototype to scalable product, with a polished experience at every step.
fullstack.overview: I design and build complete web applications — modern interfaces, robust business logic, and reliable deployments. My approach combines technical rigor with product sensibility to deliver premium digital experiences built to grow with your business.
deliverables: Responsive, accessible, and carefully animated interfaces
Modular, maintainable architecture ready to scale
API integration, authentication, and data management
Performance, SEO, and deployment best practices
Technical documentation and clear handoff to your team
approach: Understand your users, business constraints, and product goals
Define a clear architecture and consistent design system
Develop in short iterations with testable deliverables
Test, optimize, and deploy in production-like conditions
idealFor: Startups launching a premium MVP quickly
Teams looking for a reliable full-stack partner
SaaS products in a growth phase

ai-integration.title: AI Integration
ai-integration.summary: LLM-powered features, agent systems, RAG pipelines, and intelligent automation for your product.
ai-integration.tagline: Useful, reliable AI features integrated naturally into your product.
ai-integration.overview: I integrate artificial intelligence where it creates real value — not for hype, but to automate, accelerate, and enrich the user experience. From conversational assistants to RAG pipelines, I build pragmatic, observable AI systems tailored to your business context.
deliverables: OpenAI, OpenRouter, or local model integrations via Ollama
RAG pipelines with semantic search and vector databases
Intelligent automation agents and workflows
User interfaces to interact with AI capabilities
Monitoring, guardrails, and API cost management
approach: Identify high-impact AI use cases for your product
Prototype quickly to validate relevance and response quality
Build a modular, testable, and evolvable architecture
Iterate with real feedback before production deployment
idealFor: Products adding a copilot or intelligent assistant
Teams automating repetitive tasks with AI
Platforms leveraging data through semantic search
Startups experimenting with AI without over-engineering

api-backend.title: API & Backend
api-backend.summary: Robust REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, authentication, and third-party integrations.
api-backend.tagline: Solid backend foundations for reliable, well-structured products.
api-backend.overview: I build backends designed for longevity — clear, secure, and performant APIs. Whether for a new product or a rebuild, I set up backend architectures that simplify integration, maintenance, and scaling.
deliverables: Designed and documented REST or GraphQL APIs
Authentication, authorization, and session management
Database modeling and migrations
Payment, webhook, and third-party integrations
Testing, logging, and deployment strategy
approach: Analyze data flows and security constraints
Model the domain and define explicit API contracts
Implement with proven patterns and test coverage
Document, deploy, and support frontend integration
idealFor: Applications needing a reliable, well-documented API
Fintech or SaaS projects with security requirements
Frontend teams looking for a robust backend

data-engineering.title: Data Engineering
data-engineering.summary: ETL pipelines, data warehousing, analytics infrastructure, and dashboard development.
data-engineering.tagline: Turn raw data into reliable, actionable insights.
data-engineering.overview: I design reliable data pipelines that connect your data sources to informed decisions. From extraction to visualization, I use modern tools and proven practices to structure, clean, and make your data usable.
deliverables: Automated and monitored ETL/ELT pipelines
Data warehouse modeling and structuring
Talend, Airflow, dbt, and SQL Server integrations
Analytics dashboards and executive reporting
Pipeline documentation and data governance
approach: Map your data sources and analytics needs
Design a data architecture suited to your volume and constraints
Implement pipelines with validation and error recovery
Deliver clear dashboards and train teams to use them
idealFor: Organizations transitioning to a data-driven culture
